name: l71-button-lock
description: R2's CLAIM, put to the game. The boot drops the player exactly on L71's button at (120,184) — Button rect [116,124)x[181,187) — whose Activators group 0 also holds the Lock at [112,128)x[160,176), the only way north to Dungeon 7. The two volumes are DISJOINT by one pixel of y, so the player cannot stand on both: they hold the button for the 101 ticks Lock.activationStep needs (alpha -= 0.01 per tick, tested BEFORE decrementing, with Image.alpha clamping at 0), then walk up — leaving the button and entering the lock in the SAME tick, after which returnToNormal cannot fire because the player is inside it. Its control is l71-lock-shut, which walks up immediately and must be stopped dead.
